nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Ownable; grants privileged access to onlyOwner functions.
Pausable flag toggled by pause/unpause to gate attack and revive.
Address of the Ether Dungeon core interface contract, used for external hero/player queries.
Fee (0.04 ether) required to start a dungeon run; owner-configurable.
Fee (0.02 ether) required to revive/reset a hero run; owner-configurable.
Accumulated jackpot balance funded by entrance fees and revive fees.
Pool holding collected entrance fees until refunded or moved to jackpot.
Mapping from hero ID to the current Monster struct (creationTime, level, health).
Mapping from hero ID to its remaining health during a run.
Mapping from hero ID to the fee amount already refunded for that hero.
Private seed feeding the pseudo-random number generator.
Base monster health per level (10).
Time (8 minutes) after which a monster flees and attacks the hero.
Ownable constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
onlyOwner + whenNotPaused function setting paused = true.
onlyOwner + whenPaused function setting paused = false.
onlyOwner function that selfdestructs the contract sending balance to owner.
onlyOwner function that selfdestructs and sends balance to _recipient.
External payable entry point of the game; validates hero ownership, collects entrance fee, refunds excess, resolves run end and forwards to _attack.
External payable function resetting a hero run, adding reviveFee to jackpot and refunding excess.
onlyOwner setter for the edCoreContract address.
onlyOwner setter for entranceFee.
onlyOwner setter for reviveFee.
Internal combat resolver: computes hero/monster damage, pays rewards, updates jackpot/pool/health and emits LogAttack.
Private PRNG returning _seed % _upper after reseeding with blockhash/coinbase/difficulty.
View function returning hero and monster state plus derived game state; uses 'now' for flee/end logic.
View function returning all game settings constants and fees.
Caller-controlled address; owner checks, hero ownership checks and ether transfers target it.
'now' used for monster creation/flee timing and run-end determination (timestamp dependency).
selfdestruct(owner) in destroy; unconditionally destroys the contract sending funds to owner.
selfdestruct(_recipient) in destroyAndSend; sends remaining balance to an arbitrary address.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value - entranceFee) / msg.sender.transfer(msg.value) inside attack; external value transfer to caller.
msg.sender.transfer(rewards) inside _attack; pays checkpoint/breakeven/jackpot rewards to the caller.
entranceFeePool -= rewards; unchecked pool arithmetic that can underflow given refund bookkeeping.
heroIdToHealth[_heroId] -= damageByMonster; unchecked health arithmetic in _attack.
_seed = uint(keccak256(_seed, blockhash, coinbase, difficulty)); weak/block-dependent randomness.
Parameter of transferOwnership: new owner address.
Parameter of destroyAndSend: address receiving the destroyed contract balance.
Parameter of setEdCoreContract: new core contract address.
Parameter of setEntranceFee: new entrance fee value.
Parameter of setReviveFee: new revive fee value.
Parameter of attack (and forwarded to _attack): hero identifier under play.
Parameter of _attack: hero gene value used for power calculation.
Parameter of _attack: hero strength derived from genes.
Parameter of _attack: hero health at the time of the attack.
Parameter of _getRandomNumber: exclusive upper bound for the random value.
Local in attack holding genes read from edCoreContract.getHeroDetails.
Local in attack holding the hero owner returned by getHeroDetails.
Local in attack: (genes / 32**8) % 32 + 1.
Local in attack: (genes / 32**12) % 32 + 1.
Local copy of the Monster struct for the hero.
Local in attack holding monster.level.
Local in attack holding heroIdToHealth[_heroId].
Local flag in attack indicating the run has ended due to flee/timeout.
Local in attack: entranceFee - refundedFee moved to the jackpot.
Local in _attack: damage dealt by the hero, depends on tx.gasprice and PRNG.
Local in _attack: counter-damage dealt by the monster.
Local in _attack: refund/jackpot payout for checkpoint, breakeven or jackpot levels.
Local in _attack flag: damageByHero >= monster.health.
Local in _attack: hero power from edCoreContract.getHeroPower.
Local in _attack: currentLevel + 1 for the next monster.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value - reviveFee) inside revive; external value transfer to caller.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
Constructor writes the owner state variable, establishing privileged role.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier guards pause().
pause() sets paused = true.
onlyOwner modifier guards unpause().
unpause() sets paused = false.
onlyOwner modifier guards destroy().
destroy() reaches selfdestruct(owner), which is privilege protected.
_recipient parameter flows into destroyAndSend.
onlyOwner modifier guards destroyAndSend().
destroyAndSend() reaches selfdestruct(_recipient).
_heroId parameter drives attack() logic.
attack() requires msg.sender == hero owner and refunds ether to msg.sender.
attack() reads and writes heroIdToMonster.
attack() initializes heroIdToHealth.
attack() performs refund transfers to the caller.
transfer to msg.sender hands control to an untrusted address that may reenter.
attack() calls internal _attack() when the run continues.
block.timestamp ('now') is read in attack() to decide whether the run ended.
attack() compares now with monster.creationTime + monsterFleeTime.
attack() increments entranceFeePool with the entrance fee.
revive() adds reviveFee to the jackpot.
revive() deletes heroIdToMonster entry.
revive() deletes heroIdToHealth entry.
revive() deletes heroIdToRefundedFee entry.
revive() refunds excess msg.value to the caller.
transfer to msg.sender in revive() can reenter the contract.
_newEdCoreContract parameter flows into setEdCoreContract.
onlyOwner modifier guards setEdCoreContract().
setEdCoreContract() changes the trusted core contract reference.
_newEntranceFee parameter flows into setEntranceFee.
onlyOwner modifier guards setEntranceFee().
setEntranceFee() changes the fee used in state-changing game logic.
_newReviveFee parameter flows into setReviveFee.
onlyOwner modifier guards setReviveFee().
setReviveFee() changes the revive fee used in revive().
_heroId parameter is forwarded into _attack().
_genes parameter feeds hero power computation in _attack().
_heroStrength parameter feeds damage computation in _attack().
_heroCurrentHealth parameter is compared against monster damage.
_attack() reads and rewrites Monster storage for the hero.
_attack() calls edCoreContract.getHeroPower externally.
_attack() decrements entranceFeePool when paying rewards.
Unchecked entranceFeePool subtraction mutates pool state.
_attack() subtracts monster damage from hero health.
Unchecked hero health subtraction mutates heroIdToHealth.
_attack() transfers rewards to the caller.
reward transfer to msg.sender hands control to untrusted caller before state settles.
_attack() reads now to detect monster flee and run termination.
_attack() zeroes or reduces heroIdToHealth on defeat.
_attack() adjusts jackpot (adds unrefunded fee, subtracts payouts).
_attack() accumulates refunded fees per hero.
_attack() calls _getRandomNumber() to roll damage randomness.
_upper parameter bounds the random result in _getRandomNumber().
_getRandomNumber() writes the reseeded _seed state variable.
_getRandomNumber() performs the PRNG seed update operation.
Current _seed value is hashed during the PRNG update.
The keccak256 result is stored back into _seed.
getRunDetails() reads now for run-end and monster-flee logic.
getRunDetails() compares now against monster creation and flee time.
getRunDetails() queries edCoreContract for hero details and power.
getRunDetails() reads heroIdToMonster.
getRunDetails() reads heroIdToHealth.
attack() stores hero genes in a local variable.
attack() stores the hero owner in a local variable for the require check.
attack() derives the hero strength local variable from genes.
attack() derives the hero initial health local variable from genes.
attack() loads the Monster struct into a local variable.
attack() copies monster.level into a local variable.
attack() copies the hero health into a local variable.
attack() computes the dungeonRunEnded local flag.
attack() computes addToJackpot from entranceFee minus refunded fee.
_attack() computes damageByHero from strength, power, PRNG and tx.gasprice.
_attack() computes damageByMonster from level, strength or PRNG.
_attack() computes rewards for checkpoint/breakeven/jackpot levels.
_attack() computes the isMonsterDefeated flag.
_attack() stores the external hero power in a local variable.
_attack() computes newLevel for the next monster.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used as the input to the ownership transfer; fold into transferOwnership.
_recipient is solely the selfdestruct beneficiary argument of destroyAndSend; fold into the function.
Setter parameter that only assigns edCoreContract; merge into setEdCoreContract.
Setter parameter that only assigns entranceFee; merge into setEntranceFee.
Setter parameter that only assigns reviveFee; merge into setReviveFee.
Hero identifier entering the game flow through the external entry point attack.
Genes are consumed only inside _attack for power calculation; merge into _attack.
Hero strength is consumed only in _attack damage computation; merge into _attack.
Hero health is consumed only in _attack defeat check; merge into _attack.
Bound parameter used only by the PRNG function; merge into _getRandomNumber.
Local copy of externally fetched genes within attack; merge into attack.
Local copy of the hero owner used for the msg.sender require check; merge into attack.
Derived local stat used to seed the attack; merge into attack.
Derived local stat used to seed hero health; merge into attack.
Local copy of the Monster struct inside attack; merge into attack.
Local snapshot of monster level used for branching; merge into attack.
Local snapshot of hero health used for branch decisions; merge into attack.
Control flag that gates the call into _attack; merge into attack.
Intermediate fee amount moved to the jackpot inside attack; merge into attack.
Damage value driving the reward and monster-health branches; merge into _attack.
Counter-damage value driving hero health reduction; merge into _attack.
Payout value feeding the external transfer operation; merge into _attack.
Branch flag for the combat resolution path; merge into _attack.
External power value used in damage formula; merge into _attack.
Next monster level used when creating the following monster; merge into _attack.
